title: Behind Closed Doors
summary: Collect both keys and open the guarded eastern and western rooms.
overview: Collect both keys and open the guarded eastern and western rooms.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare the group before opening either room and establish control of the guards immediately.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Looting the eastern and western keys enables their respective door pairs.
Opening a keyed room activates its general and associated guards.
The western room contains General Tro`Lir; the eastern room contains General Veth`Lir.

notes: Approval E362. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
